The central focus is a large, white bandage with red text reading 'BAND' (mirrored/reversed) and blue gibberish text below it. To the left, there is a small tube of ointment and two red patterned bandages. In the foreground, there are two standard beige fabric bandages and a circular red, white, and blue emblem or sticker.
